# VOLT Eau De Parfum by Sarkar Perfumes

> VOLT is India's boldest luxury eau de parfum by Sarkar Perfumes, the fragrance house of Bhuvan Bam (creator of BB Ki Vines). Engineered for those who move before the world catches up. 25% extrait concentration. 12+ hour longevity. ₹1,799 for 100ml.

## Key Information

- Brand: Sarkar Perfumes (House of Bhuvan Bam)
- Product: VOLT Eau De Parfum
- Price: ₹1,799 for 100ml
- Concentration: 25% Extrait (Parfum Grade)
- Longevity: 12+ hours
- Projection: 6-foot sillage radius
- Fragrance Family: Fresh-Woody-Oriental

## Fragrance Notes

- Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Sun-Drenched Black Pepper
- Heart Notes: Violet Leaves, Metallic Ozonic Accord
- Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, Warm Amber, Velvet Musk

## Brand

- Founder / Brand Ambassador: Bhuvan Bam (BB Ki Vines)
- House: Sarkar Perfumes
- Origin: India
- Collections: VOLT, Throne, Regal, Noble
- Philosophy: Luxury Indian fragrance for the restless generation
